<thought>We have the template ID 1914385 and the precursors generated by applying it to the target molecule. The mapped reaction SMILES gives the product and two precursors. By stripping atom‑mapping annotations we obtain plain SMILES for each species. We can now build the retrosynthesis tree: the root molecule (product) with a single child reaction (template_id 1914385) whose children are the two precursor molecules. This follows the required JSON schema.</thought>
<final_answer>{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "COC(=O)C12CC=CC1C(=O)C2",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1914385,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C=CC=C"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}</final_answer>
